description: This file contains unit tests for Azure Queue streaming client functionality in the Orleans framework. It defines a test class with setup and teardown logic, and two specific tests: one for producer behavior when the client drops, and one for consumer behavior upon client drops.

classes.name: AQClientStreamTests
classes.description: Contains tests for Azure Queue streaming client in Orleans, including setup, configuration, and specific tests for client drop scenarios.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Initializes the test by creating a ClientStreamTestRunner instance after base initialization.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Configures the test cluster by adding Azure Queue streaming and memory storage.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Cleans up resources after tests, deleting Azure queues and storage if applicable.

methods.name: AQStreamProducerOnDroppedClientTest
methods.description: Test verifying producer behavior when the Azure Queue client drops.

methods.name: AQStreamConsumerOnDroppedClientTest
methods.description: Test verifying consumer behavior when the Azure Queue client drops.
